criterio_pre_registrado.tau: median of |off_alternativo - off_atual| across the 13 transects, per arm
criterio_pre_registrado.regra_nao_depende: ranking by MAE and by NMAD identical to (i) in (ii-a if assessable), (ii-b) and (iii); in (ii-c) retained in >=95% of the draws
criterio_pre_registrado.regra_depende_com_ressalva: holds in ii-a/ii-b and in >=95% of ii-c but changes in iii; OR only one pair inverts with |dMAE(i)| < tau
criterio_pre_registrado.regra_depende: in ii-a or ii-b a pair with |dMAE(i)| >= tau inverts; OR a pair inverts in >5% of the ii-c draws; OR under ii-b the MAE advantage of FABDEM/ANADEM over GEDTM30 in >30m changes sign
criterio_pre_registrado.teste_decisivo: GLO-30 family (FABDEM, ANADEM) vs GEDTM30 in >30m under (ii-b)
criterio_pre_registrado.previsao_registrada_antes_de_rodar: in 20-30m, ANADEM/GEDTM30/FABDEM lie within 0.17 m of MAE of each other — the three pairs of this trio should fall into 'com ressalva' in almost any arm
